usage: deskops queue add [-h] [--task TASK] [--transition TRANSITION]
                         [--root ROOT]
                         kind

Enqueue one job of a kind declared in queue_jobs.

positional arguments:
  kind                  Job kind declared in desk/config.json queue_jobs

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --task TASK           Task id; defaults to $DESKOPS_TASK_ID
  --transition TRANSITION
                        Transition relation; defaults to $DESKOPS_TRANSITION
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
